# A Text Analysis Pipeline

Build a pipeline that tokenizes free text (e.g., incident report descriptions or
field notes on an observation) counts terms, and scores documents with TF-IDF
to find what distinguishes them. A distinct kind of analysis: text mining.

-   Tokenization and normalization turn free text into countable units.
-   Term frequency is a start; TF-IDF down-weights common terms.
-   A document becomes a vector of term weights.
-   Text pipelines need the same cleaning and validation as numeric ones.
